verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents an official first-party MCP server that connects to the user's existing AI tools. Once connected, an assistant can pull live OpenRouter data (models, prices, credits, rankings, docs) and send test messages, and a probe confirms the official MCP server docs page exists. Missing for 10: setup, auth and transport details in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The OpenRouter MCP server plugs OpenRouter into the AI tools you already use.
Once connected, your assistant can pull live OpenRouter data (models, prices, your credits, rankings, and docs) and send quick test messages, all without leaving your editor.
